svg.title: Transposed-convolution length: count the overlapping extent
svg.desc: For one spatial direction, input length 14, kernel length 4, and stride 2 produce 30 positions before boundaries are removed. Padding 1 removes one position on each side, leaving 28.
svg.text: Transposed-convolution length: count the overlapping extent
One direction of a 14×14 input. Some input rows are omitted; all 30 output positions are shown.
Each cell: input value × kernel weight. Results at the same output position are added.
Inputs 3–12 also move the start by 2.
Remove one position on each side: 30 − 1 − 1 = 28
This diagram explains size and connections; it does not imply an inverse that recovers original values.
